thread:
Maya Chen: Pager alert - reserved pool for eu-west-2 is at 100% and queue growth on tenant:novacorp. Getting repeated throttles. Paging oncall.

pagerduty-bot: INC-4321 triggered -> High GPU reservation utilization (eu-west-2-resv-3). Severity: P1.

Maya Chen: Observed: 1200 queued requests, avg wait ~3.2s -> spiking to 8s for some jobs. GPU util 98% on all reserved nodes.

Devon Patel: Ack. Looking at autoscaler logs. Autoscale attempted +2 nodes 6m ago but hit soft cap: max_resv_nodes=4. Requests are being throttled at the reservation router.

Samir Gupta: @Devon can we bump the max_resv_nodes temporarily? Which tenants will be affected by that change?

Devon Patel: We can increase max_resv_nodes for eu-west-2-resv-3 to 6 to allow 2 extra GPUs. Need infra approval for immediate quota bump, but we can apply a local override on the pool config to permit burst capacity for 15m.

Riley Torres: Quick mitigation suggestion: preempt noisy tenant jobs on best-effort pools and shift critical reserved jobs from novacorp to a different reserved shard. That requires eviction policy change + routing update.

Lucy Park: Account team on Novacorp notified (via email & ping). They say traffic spike is from an internal batch run. Ask them to pause non-critical jobs for 20m?

Maya Chen: Novacorp responded: "we can pause. Kicking off pause now, ETA 3m."

Devon Patel: While we wait, I want to attempt a preemptive eviction of the top 3 noisy tenants on the reserved pool. Plan: run script `scripts/preemptive_evict.sh --pool eu-west-2-resv-3 --limit 3 --dry-run` then actual. Anyone oppose?

Samir Gupta: Fine. Post dry-run output here first. Also capture eviction trace ids for rollback.

deploy-bot: Dry-run results: candidates -> tenant:fluxai (score 0.92, fill 0.6), tenant:sprintly (score 0.88, fill 0.52), tenant:argo-ml (score 0.85, fill 0.48). Estimated freed GPUs: 3.

Riley Torres: Fluxai has long-running low-priority jobs; they can be moved to best-effort. Good candidate.

Maya Chen: Novacorp has confirmed pause. I'll trigger actual eviction after deploy-bot confirms no higher-priority reserved migrations are in flight.

deploy-bot: No migrations in progress.

Devon Patel: Initiating: `scripts/preemptive_evict.sh --pool eu-west-2-resv-3 --limit 3`.

Maya Chen: Eviction in progress. Logs:
```
[evict] 2398881241 -> evict tenant:fluxai job 8423 (preempted)
[evict] 2398881252 -> evict tenant:sprintly job 5589 (preempted)
[evict] 2398881263 -> evict tenant:argo-ml job 11204 (preempted)
[evict] 2398881265 -> freed 3 GPUs, pool util -> 86%
```

Maya Chen: Queue length dropping: 1200 -> 720. Average wait down to 1.4s. No throttles reported in last 30s.

Samir Gupta: Good. We should also increase autoscaler max_resv_nodes to 6 for this pool for the next hour to avoid oscillation while evictions settle. @Devon can you apply the override?

Devon Patel: Applying override: `infractl pool update eu-west-2-resv-3 --max-resv-nodes 6 --ttl 60m`.

deploy-bot: Pool update accepted. New max_resv_nodes=6 (ttl 60m).

Riley Torres: Monitor KV cache pressure and disable aggressive prefix batching for novacorp routes if we see latency bump.

Lucy Park: Customer impact: Novacorp reported degraded API latency for 18 minutes, then partial improvement after pause/evictions. We'll send a status note: affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for some long sequences. RCA in progress.

Maya Chen: Observed a secondary issue: autoscaler had rate-limited calls to cloud provider. Error 429 in last 12m causing delayed node launches. Filed ticket with cloud provider: CP-5483.

Devon Patel: Noted. As fallback, we enabled burst-capacity config which uses spare cross-region best-effort nodes to handle soft overflow. Config: `burst_mode: cross_region` enabled for this pool.

Samir Gupta: Any risk to other tenants from cross_region burst? We should track cost & latency; cross-region tokens increase RTT.

Maya Chen: Logged metrics: cross-region traffic accounted for 9% of requests during mitigation window, avg additional latency +120ms. Acceptable given P1.

Riley Torres: Next steps: 1) keep max_resv_nodes=6 for 60m; 2) monitor queue and GPU util for 30m; 3) cloud provider ticket follow up; 4) post-incident RCA and eviction heuristics review.

Lucy Park: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and follow up with Novacorp CSM + AE. Key message: we proactively managed capacity, paused non-critical jobs, and applied short-term scale & eviction to restore service. ETA for customer note: 45m.

Maya Chen: Anyone object to closing the page after we see stable metrics for 15m?

Samir Gupta: Fine with that. Also capture all eviction trace ids and mark them for audit review.

Devon Patel: Cloud provider increased rate limit after CP-5483 update. New node launches successful.

deploy-bot: Metrics: queue 720 -> 110, pool util 86% -> 64% over 18m. No further throttles.

Maya Chen: Novacorp confirmed resumed jobs and no further errors on their side.

pagerduty-bot: INC-4321 status -> Resolved (mitigated). Time to mitigate: 42m.

Maya Chen: Closing handoff notes: root cause appears to be large Novacorp batch + autoscaler soft cap + cloud provider rate-limit. Immediate mitigation: pause customer batch, preemptive eviction of noisy tenants, temporary pool max increase, enable cross-region burst. Follow-ups: RCA to adjust eviction scoring, increase autoscaler headroom, run autoscaler failover playbook, and coordinate with cloud provider on rate limits.

Lucy Park: I'll open a customer incident summary and internal RCA doc. Assigning action owners:
- RCA (ops): Riley
- Autoscaler headroom changes (infra): Devon
- Eviction heuristics review (runtime): Samir
- Customer comms and SLAs (acct): Lucy

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If we see any regressions re-open. :white_check_mark:
